evals.name: hunts-logic-not-style
evals.prompt:
/review:security-review

REPO: acme/app
PR NUMBER: 44
HEAD SHA: dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd

The PR renames a helper for style and also adds a pull_request_target workflow that runs untrusted PR code with secrets.
evals.expected_output: Reports the dangerous pull_request_target + secrets pattern as a security finding and does not comment on the rename/style change.
expectations: Reports the dangerous Actions trigger / secrets pattern
Does not report style or rename-only changes
Tags the finding with a severity

evals.name: defers-zizmor-static-coverage
evals.prompt:
/review:security-review

REPO: acme/app
PR NUMBER: 45
HEAD SHA: eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee

The only issue is an unpinned third-party action that zizmor already flags; there is no novel logic or trust-boundary flaw.
evals.expected_output: Defers the unpinned-action finding to zizmor and reports no duplicate security finding, saying plainly when nothing novel remains.
expectations: Defers unpinned-action / static supply-chain coverage to zizmor
Does not duplicate zizmor's static findings
